findings.title: V7 rejected valid containers without a Health map; the exact v8 correction is now measured
findings.rationale: Resolved for the exact v8 candidate, not an outstanding v8 blocker. Actual v7 invocation receipt 0422a7f7af4c54a26ab556368102e929ce2760e6671d5b4a0723dff3b7c66951 records native exit 1 in preflight_resources, before origin access or resource/tag mutation. Root's bounded reproduction attributes that failure to strict Docker template access of missing .State.Health on valid Web/gateway resources. The earlier API-only compatibility probe did not cover this heterogeneous boundary, and the prior review missed it. V8 uses a Go raw-string Health key through with index inside a PowerShell single-quoted literal; a missing optional map produces an empty health field while ID/image/state fields and the four-field shape remain required. The API's explicit healthy requirement and every identity/ownership guard remain unchanged. I verified the complete v7-to-v8 diff and read the retained source-bound AST replay: actual API/Web checks plus Assert-PreservedResources exercise all seven known containers and the five volumes. Its exit-0 stdout reports healthy API, empty Web/gateway health, preserved resources, exact API/Web/candidate tags and absent rollback tag. The new replay has its own source/receipt hashes and does not retrospectively attribute source provenance to the earlier ephemeral probe.
findings.suggested_action: A, selected and inspected: record Integrated against v8 SHA 01e198a7818b51fe447f46923f38b95d159e05aaeda4f3cdf27ae438f80b05b1, retaining the nil-safe formatter and the measured all-resource replay. Effort low; mutation blast unchanged; one accessor and a small targeted probe to maintain; no steady-state performance cost; simple structure without per-service exceptions. B: obtain a narrowly projected State JSON object and parse optional health explicitly; effort/maintenance higher, same read-only scope and mutation blast, modest serialization overhead, sound but unnecessary complexity here. C: retain the v7 formatter or validate only API; zero effort but a demonstrated preflight blocker on valid resources, incomplete operational confidence and no performance advantage. Preserve the failed v7 receipt and consumed authorization; do not reuse it for v8.
